name: 迪莫
habitat: 七日登录第 7 天赠送
evolution: 迪莫 → 圣光迪莫 / 圣火迪莫 / 圣水迪莫 / 圣草迪莫（首领化超进化）
evolutionEn: Dimo → Sacred Light / Fire / Water / Grass Dimo (Alpha Ultra Evolution)
description: 国服人气核心精灵，光系万金油，七日登录第 7 天免费获得。被动「最好的伙伴」造成克制伤害后提升攻击/防御/速度并回复能量，PVE 全能输出、PVP 稳定增益。S2 赛季开放圣火、圣水、圣光、圣草四种超进化形态，需消耗首领血脉与超进化石。
descriptionEn: The most popular CN core Jinie and a Light-type all-rounder, earned free on Day 7 of login. Its passive "Best Buddy" boosts ATK/DEF/SPD and restores energy after super-effective hits, making it a PVE workhorse and a stable PVP booster. S2 added four Ultra Evolutions (Sacred Fire / Water / Light / Grass) requiring Alpha Blood and Ultra Evolution Stones.

name: 火花
habitat: 开局三选一御三家
evolution: 火花 → 焰火（Lv16）→ 火神（Lv36）→ 烈火战神（超进化）
evolutionEn: Huohua → Flame (Lv16) → Huoshen (Lv36) → Blazing War God (Ultra Evolution)
description: 火系御三家，物攻与速度三只中最高。被动「助燃」释放火系技能后物攻 +20%（可叠加），越打越强。前期开荒与推主线最快，克制大量草系/虫系野怪；10 级后可在好友世界捕捉其它御三家。
descriptionEn: The Fire-type starter with the highest ATK and SPD of the three. Its "Combustion" passive adds +20% ATK after each Fire move (stackable), ramping up the longer a fight goes. Fastest early-game and story progression; the other starters can be caught in friends' worlds after level 10.

name: 水蓝蓝

evolution: 水蓝蓝 → 波波拉（Lv16）→ 水灵（Lv36）→ 圣水守护（超进化）
evolutionEn: Shuilanlan → Bobola (Lv16) → Shuilin (Lv36) → Sacred Water Guardian (Ultra Evolution)
description: 水系御三家，特性「浸润」释放水系技能后技能能耗 -1，近乎零耗输出。双防与生命均衡、生存稳健，控制技能充足，进化水灵后 PVP 与持久战强势，是后期对战体系的核心之一。
descriptionEn: The Water-type starter with the "Permeation" trait: Water skills cost 1 less energy, enabling near-zero-cost output. Balanced defenses and HP plus solid control skills; after evolving into Shuilin it becomes a PVP and long-game cornerstone.

name: 喵喵
habitat: 开局三选一御三家
evolution: 喵喵 → 喵呜（Lv16）→ 魔力猫（Lv36）→ 叶冕魔力猫（首领进化）
evolutionEn: Miaomiao → Miaowu (Lv16) → Molicat (Lv36) → Leaf-Crown Molicat (Alpha Evolution)
description: 草系御三家，特性「氧循环」使用草系技能回复 10% 生命（首领化 20%），坦度与续航御三家最高。进化喵呜、魔力猫后成为队伍堡垒，首领进化叶冕魔力猫后续航与增益兼备，佛系开荒首选。
descriptionEn: The Grass-type starter with the "Oxygen Cycle" trait: Grass skills heal 10% of max HP (20% in Alpha form) — the tankiest and most self-sustaining of the three. Evolving through Miaowu into Molicat makes it a team fortress, with the Alpha form adding sustain and buffs.

name: 皇家狮鹫
habitat: 天空城（捕捉小狮鹫起养成）
habitatEn: Sky City (catch the cub and raise it)
evolution: 小狮鹫 → 神圣狮鹫（Lv32）→ 皇家狮鹫（Lv46）

description: 翼系人气精灵，物攻与速度出色。被动「乘风连击」使用翼系技能后连击数 +1，配合羽化加速先手压制，PVE 收割与 PVP 速攻都有出场空间；页游时代的情怀坐骑之王，如今仍是队伍里的高速物攻手。
descriptionEn: A popular Flying-type Jinie with strong ATK and SPD. Its "Wind Combo" passive grants +1 combo after each Flying skill, and Wing Dash secures the first move — solid in both PVE finishing and PVP rush teams. The page-game era's iconic mount king remains a fast physical attacker.

descriptionEn: A Ground/Dark physical juggernaut with top-tier ATK stats. Its "Stone Feast" trait spends 5% HP in place of 1 energy when short, and with Greed's 100% lifesteal it forms an infinite drain loop — a PVE all-rounder and boss-fight staple.

habitat: 雪人谷 / 怀特冰川捕捉
evolution: 雪娃娃 → 冰封怨灵（Lv26）→ 雪灵（Lv42）
evolutionEn: Xuewawa → Ice Wraith (Lv26) → Xueling (Lv42)
description: 冰系控制精灵，进化冰封怨灵后特性「冰封」使敌方全技能能耗 +1，配合能耗施压类技能可让 BOSS 长时间无法出手，PVE BOSS 战特化；PVP 控场压制。克制草、地面、龙、飞行系，身板偏脆需注意保护。
descriptionEn: An Ice-type control Jinie. Evolving into Ice Wraith adds the "Frozen Seal" trait (all enemy skills cost +1 energy), and combined with energy-pressure skills can lock bosses out of acting — a PVE boss specialist and PVP control pick. Beats Grass, Ground, Dragon, and Flying, though its frail frame needs protection.

habitat: 风铃岛野外随机刷新（中级以上咕噜球）
evolution: 优优 → 优光绒绒 / 绒光优优（Lv36 进化，最终形态）
evolutionEn: Youyou → Youguang Rongrong (Lv36, final form)
description: 地系 T0 精灵（官方图鉴名：绒光优优，光/地系技能双修）。特性「哨兵」回合开始时若敌方技能足以击败自身，则速度 +50 并在行动后脱离，折返高频上下场掌控节奏；配合流沙 / 摇篮曲控场、硬化 + 放晴强化双防与输出，控场、增益、输出三位一体。
descriptionEn: A Ground-type T0 Jinie (officially "Rongguang Youyou") blending Light and Ground skills. Its "Sentinel" trait grants +50 SPD and a post-action pivot when an enemy move would KO it at turn start — enabling tempo-controlling switch-ins. With Quicksand / Lullaby control plus Harden and Clear Sky boosts, it covers control, buffing, and damage in one.
